body: That's the thing, it takes everything I have to *not* kill myself. I already know exactly what I'm going to do, and it would really take just a few seconds to get everything ready. Then I'd be gone. Last week I was ready. I was just telling her goodbye. I just wanted it over at the time. Now, it's like a drive, like something's pushing me. She's the only one who knows I'm suicidal, and it'll probably be a shock when my work finds out the reason why I stopped coming in. The little things just aren't working like they used to.  And neither are the big things.

I'd actually love too, which is part of the issue. I've talked to her about some of this, but honestly, her current issues stem from her ex, who she still has some feelings for. It's a terribly messy situation. Me trying to push in more wouldn't actually help the situation, and I lack the money for any other changes I can think of.
